_about: Charles Merivale (1808-1893), later Dean of Ely: History of the Romans under the Empire, the Longmans new edition in eight volumes, vols. I-V, each title page dated 1865 (vol. V's year reads 'ia65' in the OCR), raw IA OCR. Vol. I's imprint reads 'Longmans, Green, and Co.' and vols. II-V 'Longman, Green, Longman, Roberts, & Green'; the firm took the shorter name in 1865, so both imprints can carry that year. Vols. VI-VIII were found only in later impressions of the same edition and are taken from them: VI 1868, VIII 1872, VII a 'new impression' whose year reads 'lu04' in the OCR (read as 1904, the year of the matching vol. VI impression on IA; an inference). All are pre-1930 printings, so the post-1930 later-printings question does not arise. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted.
